convert_stable_audio_weights: run the script to convert Stable Audio model weights to a diffusers pipeline
convert_state_dict: create a function that converts a Stable Audio state dict to diffusers format with renamed keys
build_projection_model: build a StableAudioProjectionModel from text encoder dimensions and conditioning configuration
build_dit_model: build a StableAudioDiTModel transformer with attention heads and cross-attention dimensions
save_pipeline: save a StableAudioPipeline with transformer, VAE, and scheduler to a directory or Hugging Face hub
